name: Normalized Mesh SDF Sampling
definition: Samples a 3D signed distance field stored in a 1D array, mapping normalized coordinates [-1, 1] to grid indices, applying boundary handling, and adjusting for voxel size.
summary: Normalized Mesh SDF Sampling retrieves signed distance values from a 1D array while handling out-of-bounds queries by approximating distance to the bounding box to prevent interpolation artifacts.
